instructions: Read existing dashboards and match keys/titles before creating. Preserve legacy insights and data; update or clearly label old coverage instead of deleting.
Resolve the project from authenticated PostHog UI/API and verify it matches the public capture token without printing the token.
Resolve each dashboard ID, then POST/PATCH insight bodies with name, description, tags, query, and dashboards=[resolved_id]. Never send the local key field to the API.
Use existing account defaults for visibility. Do not enable public dashboard sharing or email subscriptions.
Validate query nodes through the authenticated query endpoint, inspect rendered insights, and record resulting dashboard URLs. Empty results at cutover are expected; do not fabricate historic events.
Set cutover_date to the actual production release date after verification.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Website & downloads
dashboards.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people. Download clicks do not establish completed downloads or installs. Referral sources describe the immediate referrer; they are not persistent marketing attribution.

insights.name: Consenting browsers visiting PixelWall
insights.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people.

insights.name: Page views by area
insights.description: Page view totals, split into fixed page groups; no raw path or query reporting.

insights.name: Page views by immediate referral source
insights.description: Immediate referrer classification only. A later internal page can replace the external source. direct_or_unknown combines direct visits and unavailable referrers.

insights.name: Navigation clicks by destination
insights.description: Fixed link destinations only; repeated clicks count as repeated events.

insights.name: Desktop download clicks by platform
insights.description: Clicks on versioned download links. This does not measure download completion, installation, or app use.

insights.name: Desktop download clicks by release
insights.description: Useful during release rollout; click totals can include retries.

insights.name: Downloads page → desktop download click
insights.description: Ordered anonymous-browser funnel, within 1 day. Does not include a completed-download or installation step.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Editor & exports
dashboards.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people. Generated exports indicate files prepared by the editor; they do not prove the user saved a file to disk. Activation funnel is scoped to the current workbench.

insights.name: Editor browsers by version
insights.description: Anonymous browser counts by workbench/classic. A load is not a meaningful edit.

insights.name: Workbench → meaningful edit → generated export
insights.description: Ordered within 1 day. Activation is measured only after consent; existing artwork does not produce historical activation. Export completion is editor generation, not disk-save confirmation.

insights.name: First meaningful editor actions
insights.description: First meaningful edit recorded by the current consented editor lifecycle; fixed action classes only.

insights.name: Workbench tool adoption
insights.description: Counts anonymous browsers using each tool family; no pointer paths, artwork, or stroke contents.

insights.name: Generated exports by format
insights.description: Files generated by the editor. The browser/OS may cancel or decline the subsequent save.

insights.name: Export starts, completions, failures, and blocks
insights.description: Independent counts, not a success-rate formula: starts can complete in another time bucket and repeated export attempts are separate.

insights.name: Completed imports by format
insights.description: Fixed format categories; no filenames or imported content.

insights.name: External automation operations
insights.description: Coarse successful external-control operation counts. This measures the free scripting interface, not embedded AI, and sends no script or command arguments.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Pro & reliability
dashboards.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people. Live checkout outcomes only where a billing mode applies. Verified ownership claims are browser-observed entitlement events, not authoritative payments or revenue; discounts, gifts, retries, refunds, taxes, and unconsented purchases are not revenue accounting.

insights.name: Pro details → checkout → verified ownership
insights.description: Ordered within 7 days. Billing-mode filters are on payment steps only because dialog events do not carry billing mode. Return URL success is deliberately not the paid/verified conversion step. Browser identifiers may change across devices or after storage resets.

insights.name: Checkout start → Stripe → verified ownership
insights.description: Operational conversion among consented live-checkout attempts. Entitlement success requires a verified owned license; online-only legacy access is shown separately.

insights.name: Pro views by opening source
insights.description: Dialog opening source is menu, export gate, or checkout return. Already-visible dialogs do not add another view.

insights.name: Live ownership claims and restores
insights.description: Not revenue or unique purchases. A retry or browser/device change can emit another entitlement event, and restoration is not a sale.

insights.name: Live claim outcomes
insights.description: success means signed ownership verified; online_only means server-accepted access without a verified portable license; failure means the operation failed.

insights.name: Live checkout failures by reason
insights.description: Finite reason categories only. No Stripe messages, checkout IDs, recovery codes, or project names.

insights.name: Export failures by reason
insights.description: Fixed failure categories only; generated artwork and document contents remain private.

insights.name: Import failures by reason
insights.description: Fixed failure categories only; filenames and source content remain private.

insights.name: Autosave failures and recoveries
insights.description: Reported only while analytics consent is active; missed offline/declined visits are not evidence of no failures.

insights.name: LCP — 75th percentile
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Page-lifetime performance metrics from consenting browsers; not a score for all visitors. LCP and INP are milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

insights.name: INP — 75th percentile
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Page-lifetime performance metrics from consenting browsers; not a score for all visitors. LCP and INP are milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

insights.name: CLS — 75th percentile
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Page-lifetime performance metrics from consenting browsers; not a score for all visitors. LCP and INP are milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

insights.name: Scrubbed browser error reports
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Messages, stack traces, private URLs and document content are removed. Counts are reports, not distinct root causes.
